subject: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum
content:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Iris Wu <iris@fluxpay.com>, Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum

Hi Iris / Evan,

Thanks again for the call today — great to hear FluxPay is seeing production growth in the API gateway flow. Per our renewal discussion I put together a short proposal for the premium SLA attachments so we can lock terms into the renewal amendment. High level:

- Proposed term: 12 months (auto-renew opt-in)
- New premium SLO: p99.9 latency <= 200ms for text generation endpoints (measured at Redwood edge per request logs)
- Dedicated on-call: 24/7 on-call engineer and a dedicated escalation path for critical incidents (P0/P1) with 1-hour initial response SLA
- Capacity: reserved dedicated GPU pool sized for your 95th percentile baseline with burst window (details in attached MAP)
- Credits: tiered credit matrix (see SLO appendix) — credits accrue monthly if SLO missed, capped at 20% of monthly invoice
- Price delta: +3.0% ARR uplift over current committed spend for the premium SLO + on-call package (detailed in FluxPay-MAP.xlsx)

I attached: Redwood-Premium-SLO-Appendix.pdf (technical SLO definition + measurement plan), FluxPay-MAP.xlsx (capacity & pricing worksheets), and SLO-credit-matrix.csv (credit calculation examples).

Action we need from you: please confirm the SLO target and whether the 1-hour incident response for P0/P1 meets your needs. If you prefer a lower credit cap or different penalty terms, call that out and I can route to legal.

If we get alignment this week, I’ll spin up a draft amendment and route to you for signature.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191

-----

From: Iris Wu <iris@fluxpay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@fluxpay.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 09:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum

Soojin,

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the materials — useful detail. A couple of immediate questions before we loop in procurement/legal:

1) p99.9 at 200ms — can you clarify measurement boundary? Is this at our egress region in us-west or at Redwood edge (we'd prefer client-observed latency if possible).
2) The 1-hour initial response sounds good for P0s, but we need to understand the mean time to mitigation target. Can Redwood commit to a playbook with runbook steps and a named on-call contact?
3) Credits: the cap at 20% feels high to us. Can Redwood consider 10–15% cap instead, or a staircase where the first breach gets smaller credits?

Finally — we have a compliance window mid-Oct and would like the amendment signed before Oct 20.

Thanks,

Iris Wu
Head of Platform Engineering | FluxPay
iris@fluxpay.com

-----

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Iris Wu <iris@fluxpay.com>, Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Sep 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum

Hi Iris — appreciate the detail. Quick answers and a proposed tweak:

Measurement boundary
- We measure at Redwood edge (ingress/egress hop), per-request logging. This ensures a stable, auditable signal across regions.
- If you need client-observed metrics, we can run a parallel client-side measurement during the first 30 days of the term for alignment; if there’s sustained divergence we’ll treat that as a performance investigation item (not an automatic credit trigger).

Response & mitigation
- We will assign a named on-call lead and provide a runbook (standard incident playbook + FluxPay-specific escalation). Our commitment: initial response within 1 hour for P0/P1; estimated median mitigation window for transient infra issues is 2–4 hours, complex mitigations vary.
- We will include a 24/7 named escalation contact in the amendment.

Credits/penalty cap
- We can accept moving the credit cap from 20% down to 15% for the first 12-month term if FluxPay signs the dedicated capacity commitment in the MAP. If you prefer a staircase approach, proposed alternative: first breach month — 5% credit, second breach in a rolling 3-mo window — 10%, subsequent breach — 15% (capped). Let me know which you prefer.

Price/commitment
- The +3% uplift assumes dedicated pool sized to your 95th baseline and the named on-call support. If you reduce reserved capacity threshold or remove the on-call, uplift reduces accordingly.

Next steps I recommend:
- Confirm credit cap preference (15% vs staircase)
- Confirm whether the parallel client-side measurement is acceptable during first 30 days
- Once confirmed we’ll produce an amendment + DocuSign envelope and route to legal/procurement.

Attaching SLO-credit-matrix.csv with the staircase example (rows show monthly invoice, measured breach magnitude, credit %) for clarity.

Best,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Iris Wu <iris@fluxpay.com>, Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@fluxpay.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 14:22:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum

Iris / Evan — quick technical addendum from the reliability side:

- Runbook: we will provide a FluxPay-specific runbook that includes: signal definitions (p50/p95/p99/p99.9), incident severity matrix, on-call rotation contacts, and a play-by-play mitigation checklist.
- Named on-call: we will commit to a primary and secondary named engineer for the first 90 days. After 90 days we will transition to a rotation with guaranteed overlap.
- Network considerations: the tail SLO is sensitive to egress variability. We recommend the dedicated pool be provisioned in the same cloud region as your traffic peak (us-west-2) to minimize cross-region hops. If FluxPay requires multi-region HA, we will include a separate regional pool estimate in the MAP.
- Legal flag: the 15% cap concession triggers an approval from Commercial Legal; I suggest Soojin include that note when circulating the amendment.

I’ll prepare the runbook template and share a draft in the shared Drive link once we have confirmation on the credit structure.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Reliability Engineering | Redwood Inference

-----

From: Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@fluxpay.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Iris Wu <iris@fluxpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum

Soojin / team,

Thanks — FluxPay is aligned to move forward with the following (final):

- p99.9 latency <= 200ms measured at Redwood edge
- 1-hour initial response for P0/P1, with named on-call lead + primary/secondary for first 90 days
- Credit cap set to 15% for first 12-month term (Commercial Legal to review amendment)
- Dedicated pool in us-west-2; we will evaluate multi-region needs next quarter

Please send the draft amendment and DocuSign link to procurement (procure@fluxpay.com) and copy me. Our target: executed before Oct 20 to meet our compliance window.

Evan

-----

From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Evan Lowe <evan.lowe@fluxpay.com>, Iris Wu <iris@fluxpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal proposal: FluxPay — latency tail SLO + dedicated on-call addendum

Evan — perfect, thanks for the confirmation. I’ll:

1) Draft the amendment with the 15% cap and named on-call language, route to Commercial Legal for approval.
2) Create the DocuSign envelope and include procurement (procure@fluxpay.com).
3) Share the runbook draft in Drive and loop Rishi for handoff.

Target: amendment sent no later than Oct 8 so legal has time for review. Will update the HubSpot deal once envelope is out.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will follow up in the shared link.

Thanks,

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
